requirements.title: Preserve lifecycle separation
requirements.criterion: Queueing is not budget reservation; reservation is not concurrency ownership; ownership is not dispatch; dispatch is not settlement or publication. The sequence remains bounded queue → reserve → own dispatch → durable dispatch mark → network I/O → settle → fenced per-work publication. Queued work holds no provider capacity, reservations hold budget but not concurrency, and owned/dispatched work holds concurrency. Only proven undispatched work can be canceled/refunded. Dispatched uncertainty stays charged until explicit recovery handling; do not recreate allowance by forgetting a crashed request.
requirements.summary: Queue/reserve/ownership/dispatch/settle/publication are distinct durable transitions; uncertain sends stay charged.
